title: Dolly Parton Was All Smiles & Jokes at Final Public Appearance, 2 Months Before She Died
summary: The country star made a surprise appearance at the grand opening of Dolly's Tennessean Travel Stop in Cornersville, Tennessee.
body: Dolly Parton ‘s final public appearance came just two months before her death at age 80. The country music icon, who died Tuesday (Aug. 25), was last seen publicly on June 24, when she made a surprise appearance at the grand opening of Dolly’s Tennessean Travel Stop in Cornersville, Tennessee. Related Dolly Parton’s Half-Century Hot 100 Legacy: ‘9 to 5,’ ‘Islands in the Stream’ & More Dolly Parton’s Life in Photos: From Smoky Mountain Girl to Queen of Country Music A Timeline of Dolly Parton’s Good Deeds Parton arrived at the new travel center in a whimsical blue-and-pink fringed outfit and took part in the ribbon-cutting ceremony, greeting the crowd gathered for the occasion. The appearance was a rare one for the superstar, who was staying out of the public eye during ongoing health complications. The June event also showcased the admirable sense of humor that had long been synonymous with Parton. While welcoming guests to the travel stop, she joked about competing chain Buc-ee’s, whose mascot is a beaver. “I couldn’t leave it to beavers,” she quipped. View this post on Instagram Parton&#82…
